subject: Novabank hosting options — quick residency & routing recap
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Andrew Lin <andrew.lin@novabank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 13:12:00 +0000
Subject: Novabank hosting options — quick residency & routing recap

Andrew — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap so we all have the same picture and clear next steps.

Key points we heard from you:
- Primary requirement: EU-only data processing and storage for customer PII and transaction metadata.
- APAC presence: product needs low-latency access from Singapore and Sydney offices; APAC processing can be routed if EU residency is maintained for customer data.
- Procurement timeline: decision expected by late July; security review and PII clause will be a gating item.

How Redwood maps to those asks (short):
- Hosted API: fast to start, supports EU-only residency for inference and storage in our eu-west region. Cross-region routing (APAC failover) can be configured but requires explicit agreement on where non-PII/derivative tokens are allowed to traverse.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools in EU (eu-west-1) give you stronger isolation and predictable throughput; good middle ground if you need committed SLAs.
- Private VPC / on-prem: supports strict network controls and can be configured to avoid any cross-border egress — this is our recommended path if NovaBank legally requires zero cross-border processing. Onboarding lead time is longer (see below).

Open items / questions for you:
1) Can NovaBank accept EU-hosted inference for PII but allow APAC routing for ephemeral non-PII processing/analytics? Yes/No.
2) Do you need a written SLA for latency for APAC offices or is a documented fallback policy sufficient?
3) Any procurement constraints we should surface now (e.g., mandatory vendor security forms, specific contract language)?

Proposed next steps:
- Redwood: I will drop our Region Availability PDF and a short MAP (mutual action plan) link to the thread.
- NovaBank: confirm residency stance on the APAC routing question.
- Ops/Procurement: if you want Dedicated or Private, we can prepare a high-level onboarding timeline (Dedicated: ~2 weeks to reservation; Private VPC: ~4–6 weeks for networking and KMS integration).

Attachments: novabank-mvp-traffic-estimates.xlsx (you sent the numbers — thanks), redwood-region-availability.pdf

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Andrew Lin <andrew.lin@novabank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novabank.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Novabank hosting options — quick residency & routing recap

Jordan — really helpful summary, thanks. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Short answer on APAC routing: Our legal/compliance team is open to EU-hosted processing for PII, but any routing of traffic through APAC must ensure PII is stripped or tokenized before leaving EU. Can Redwood enforce tokenization/PII redaction at the edge?
- SLA: We will need documented latency targets for EU-hosted inference as part of our procurement pack. Not necessarily financial penalties at first, but clear SLOs.
- Procurement: please include the SOC2 attestation and a data processing addendum (DPA) template with your materials. Procurement will also ask for sample network diagrams for Dedicated vs Private.

Also: our internal infra team asked whether Dedicated capacity in EU can be configured to deny all outbound internet egress except to our approved VPC endpoints. If Dedicated requires cloud-native VPC peering, what does that look like operationally?

On timing: we still expect a rundown in July; if you can give a short proof-of-concept timeline that would help speed procurement.

—Andrew
Andrew Lin
Head of Platform Engineering | NovaBank
andrew.lin@novabank.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Novabank hosting options — quick residency & routing recap

Andrew — quick responses inline to help procurement and infra: 

- Tokenization / PII redaction: yes — Redwood can enforce PII minimization at the inference edge. We support a configurable pre-processing hook (customers provide regex/field rules or we can run a pattern-based detector) to strip/tokenize PII before it leaves the EU region. We can include that as a technical appendix in the DPA.

- Dedicated egress controls: Dedicated capacity runs in our managed subnet in the selected cloud region. We support restricting outbound egress via managed firewall rules and VPC endpoint allowlists; we can also support private peering to your VPC so that traffic never routes through public internet. I'll add a short network diagram to the Drive folder.

- Timeline and PoC: proposed two-phase PoC — Phase 1 (2 weeks): validate API + residency rules against a small sample of traffic; Phase 2 (3–4 weeks): run sandbox workloads from EU and APAC offices with tokenization rules enabled. Dedicated reservation can be provisioned in ~10 business days once PO is signed; Private VPC typically requires 4–6 weeks (networking, KMS, compliance onboarding).

I'll upload the region availability PDF I referenced and a short MAP (mutual action plan) checklist to the Drive link Jordan shared.

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
